subject: OrbitCloud - marketplace private offer pricing & staggered prepay proposal
messages:
From: Aisha Rao <procurement@orbitcloud.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@orbitcloud.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing request: marketplace private offer — prepay options for Redwood Inference

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the demo last week — OrbitCloud is very interested in a private offer through the Azure marketplace for Redwood’s inference platform. Procurement here is collecting the pricing comparison for two paths: 1-year annual prepay and a 3-year multi-year prepay. A few specific asks for your team: 

- Line-item pricing for 1-year and 3-year prepay (both committed $ and effective discount % vs list).
- Proposed ramp schedule (what committed % applies by contract year; any true-up mechanics).
- Marketplace private-offer process and who owns marketplace fees (partner vs customer).
- SKU mapping for Azure Marketplace (we need the SKU IDs to include on our PO).
- Any onboarding/implementation credits you can offer to offset ramp risk.
- Confirmation of model/version price protection for the term (we need assurances around no surprise list-price increases mid-term).

We have an internal deadline to circulate a recommended option by Aug 24. Could you send a proposed structure and any standard private-offer contract language by Tue Aug 17 EOD? Attaching our PO template for reference.

Thanks,
Aisha Rao
Sr. Procurement Manager
OrbitCloud

Attachment: OrbitCloud_PO_Template.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rao <procurement@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing request: marketplace private offer — prepay options for Redwood Inference

Hi Aisha — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear asks. Drafting two concise options below and attaching a price matrix + SKU mapping. Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk the numbers.

Option A — 1 year, annual prepay (simple):
- Commitment: 100% prepay for 12 months
- Listed annual value: $1,200,000
- Offer: 12% discount off list (effective price: $1,056,000)
- Marketplace: Private Offer via Azure; customer signs PO / marketplace private-offer flow.
- True-up: none within year; monthly usage reports.

Option B — 3 year, multi-year prepay (with ramp):
- Total list (3yr): $3,600,000 (assumes base consumption growth)
- Structure: annual prepay commitment invoiced each year up front; we offer a multi-year discount schedule.
- Suggested ramp & discount by contract year:
  Year 1: 50% of Year-1 budget prepaid (effective discount 18% on Year-1 committed portion)
  Year 2: 75% of Year-2 budget prepaid (discount 20% on Year-2 committed portion)
  Year 3: 100% of Year-3 budget prepaid (discount 22% on Year-3 committed portion)
- Blended effective discount across 3 years: ~20% vs list (final depends on committed $s each year).
- True-up: annual true-up at each renewal window (30-day reporting + invoice adjustment).

Notes on marketplace & SKUs:
- Attached is a SKU mapping file (Marketplace_Mapping_SKUs.xlsx) with the SKU IDs we recommend including on the private offer. Karthik has confirmed these map to our Azure listing.
- Marketplace fees: typically borne by customer (Azure transaction fee). We can discuss a partial credit for first-year marketplace cost if needed.

Attached: Redwood_Private_Offer_ORBIT-2027_v1.pdf (price matrix) and Marketplace_Mapping_SKUs.xlsx

If this looks close, we can prepare a DocuSign-ready private-offer doc and a redline of your PO template. If you need a steeper ramp in Year 1 we can explore a concession in onboarding credits.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
From: Aisha Rao <procurement@orbitcloud.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@orbitcloud.com
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing request: marketplace private offer — prepay options for Redwood Inference

Neha, thanks for the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups from our procurement and legal teams after reviewing the attachments: 

1) Ramp: OrbitCloud is sensitive to year-1 cash positioning. We would prefer Year-1 commit at 70% (instead of 50%) to receive the deeper blended discount. Can Redwood do Year-1 at 70% commit with a 22% discount on that committed portion?

2) Price protection: we need an explicit clause that Redwood will not increase unit list prices for the SKUs covered under the private offer for the term of the agreement (unless mutually agreed).

3) Marketplace fees: OrbitCloud would ask Redwood to absorb or credit the first-year Azure marketplace transaction fee for the private-offer flow — we see that as a reasonable concession for a 3-year commitment.

4) DocuSign/PO: please provide a DocuSign-ready private offer with SKU IDs populated so we can circulate to finance. Attached our PO to show required fields.

Can you respond with yes/no on the three negotiation points by EOD Aug 18? Procurement needs to finalize recommendation to the execs by Aug 24.

Thanks,
Aisha

Attachment: OrbitCloud_PO_Template.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: OrbitCloud asks — marketplace fee credit & ramp concession?

Marissa / Karthik,

Quick internal — OrbitCloud is asking for three things: 1) Year-1 commit at 70% with a 22% discount on that committed portion, 2) explicit price protection clause for the term, and 3) Redwood to absorb (or credit) the first-year Azure marketplace transaction fee. Procurement needs yes/no on these by EOD 18 Aug.

Impact calc (back-of-envelope):
- Current 3yr structure (50% Y1 / 75% Y2 / 100% Y3) yields ~20% blended discount. Moving to 70% Y1 at 22% on that portion increases revenue deferral and reduces realized margin in Y1. Assuming Year-1 list $1.2M, moving from 50%->70% prepaid increases cash collected but increases discount exposure we forecast ~2.5–3.5% incremental gross margin erosion over the term without offset. We can offset via: higher effective price in Year-3, smaller onboarding credit, or asking OrbitCloud to accept annual true-up that locks in usage growth so we don’t over-discount.

Proposed internal counter (to present to OrbitCloud):
- Accept Year-1 at 60% commit (middle ground) with 20% discount on Year-1 committed portion.
- Year-2: 80% commit with 21% discount. Year-3: 100% commit with 22% discount.
- Redwood will provide a one-time onboarding credit of $150,000 (applied at signing).
- Redwood will include a price-protection clause for SKUs in the private offer.
- Marketplace fee: Redwood will credit the first-year marketplace fee up to $25k (cap).

If you approve the above, I’ll send updated proposal to OrbitCloud and populate the DocuSign package + SKU IDs. We should flag to legal the exact wording for price protection and the cap on marketplace fee credit.

Thanks — Neha

(Attachment: internal margin calc spreadsheet - not included in external send)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: OrbitCloud asks — marketplace fee credit & ramp concession?

Neha / Karthik,

I support the internal counter — good compromise. A few conditions before we concede: 
- Require a minimum ARR floor: OrbitCloud must commit to a $900k ARR baseline in Year-1 (after discount) or we reserve right to reprice.
- Include an annual true-up (30 days after year-end) with automatic billing adjustments.
- Marketplace fee credit capped at $25k as you proposed.
- Legal to review price-protection clause to ensure it’s limited to the listed SKUs and explicit exceptions for third-party infrastructure cost pass-throughs.

If legal signs off on the clause language I’m comfortable approving the onboarding credit and the adjusted ramp. Please send the updated bundle to OrbitCloud with the conditions called out.

Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:44:00 -0700
Subject: Final: OrbitCloud private-offer proposal (DocuSign + SKUs) — ORBIT-2027-AZ-3Y

Hi Aisha — thanks for the patience while we reviewed internally. Please find the updated proposal and next steps below. We’ve populated the SKU IDs and prepared a DocuSign-ready private offer. Links and attachments are included. 

Summary — 3-year multi-year prepay (final proposal):
- Year 1: 60% prepaid commitment of Year-1 budget (after discount), 20% discount on the Year-1 committed portion.
- Year 2: 80% prepaid commitment, 21% discount on Year-2 committed portion.
- Year 3: 100% prepaid commitment, 22% discount on Year-3 committed portion.
- Blended effective discount across the 3-year term: ~18% (final depends on actual annual committed $s).
- One-time onboarding credit: $150,000 applied at signing (credit memo).
- Marketplace fee: Redwood will credit OrbitCloud up to $25,000 to offset the first-year Azure marketplace transaction cost.
- Price protection: Redwood will not increase unit list prices for SKUs explicitly enumerated in the private offer for the term (legal will share exact wording).
- Minimum ARR floor: $900k ARR in Year-1 (post-discount) to maintain these rates.
- Annual true-up and reporting: 30-day window after year-end for usage reconciliation and invoice adjustments.

Next steps:
1) Review the attached private-offer PDF (Redwood_Private_Offer_ORBIT-2027_v1.pdf) and SKU mapping.
2) If acceptable, sign the DocuSign private-offer link below by Aug 31 to secure the pricing and onboarding credit.
3) We’ll coordinate with your finance team to populate the PO with the SKU IDs and finalize marketplace private-offer acceptance.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCD-ORBIT-2027
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/6001/ORBIT-2027-AZ-3Y

Attachments: Redwood_Private_Offer_ORBIT-2027_v1.pdf, Marketplace_Mapping_SKUs.xlsx

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this across the finish line. Please let me know if you want to run through the contract language with legal.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
